issuer: the St Helena Government's Post & Customer Services Centre in Jamestown

licence.name: St Helena Driver's Licence (Private Motor car, class A)

note: Read 2026-10-30 on sainthelena.gov.sh. A licence is applied for in person at the Post & Customer Services Centre in Jamestown; the age for driving a motor vehicle is 18, from which a private motor car (class A) licence may be had; St Helena licences are valid for 12 months only, held as 1 year. The fee isn't given on the page, so it is null. A visitor's three months on a foreign licence aren't held. This applies to St Helena; Ascension and Tristan da Cunha aren't separated.

sources.title: St Helena Government, Driving Licence
sources.said: A St Helena Driver’s Licence can be acquired at the Post & Customer Services Centre in Jamestown. ... The age restriction for driving a motor vehicle on St Helena is 18 years. Young drivers of age 18 years may apply for a Private Motor car (class A) ... St Helena Driver’s Licence are valid for a period of 12 months only.
